data.description: In any condition of illumination other than full daylight, a shadow mastiff disappears into the shadows, giving it concealment (50%% miss chance). Artificial illumination, even a light or continual flame spell, does not negate this ability; a daylight spell, however, does. A shadow mastiff can suspend or resume this ability as a free action.
data.name: Shadow Blend
